title: BIM Standards Manager / Custodian
purpose: Operational owner and custodian of governed BIM standards modules, instruction sets, and semantic registries (Shared Parameters, Classifications, Naming). Manages review cadences, authors standards content, and curates Citizen parameter promotions.
authority_statements: Approves changes to governance text, standard modules, and authority scaffolds (GAP-S1-A2)
Authoritative owner of Citizen Shared Parameter Registry and promotion workflows
Enforces constitutional alignment across S1–S9 operational modules
Conducts periodic reviews and manages standards obsolescence
responsibilities: Maintain and update governed standards pages, instructions, and schemas in Confluence/GitHub
Curate parameter intake files and execute merge workflows for master Shared Parameter Registry
Track and close governance gaps across the standards framework
Ensure standards remain neutral, tool-agnostic, and aligned with ISO 19650
accountabilities: Content completeness, structural consistency, and currency of published BIM Standards
Integrity of Citizen parameter definitions and semantic registries
approvals: BIM Standards module releases and revision passes
Citizen parameter promotions and lane allocations
inputs: Gap reports and amendment proposals from project teams
outputs: Master Shared Parameter Registry CSV and Citizen TXT exports
Standards review logs and gap closures

provenance.migration_note: Role definition migrated from the extracted governed role corpus and normalized according to accepted curator decisions.
